summary: The proof is correct and complete. Positivity of p_empty follows strictly from U<m and M>=m; Brunn-Minkowski applies to the positive-area measurable convex exact cells; the incidence rule gives the exact multiplicities 2, 1, and 0 for singleton, doubleton, and triple R-cells, including null boundaries; all crossing substitutions and rational calibrations are correct. The example is explicitly and correctly scoped as a scalar feasibility witness for insufficiency of the listed inequalities, not as a claim of simultaneous geometric realizability.
